notes: Routing registry for the workspace agent layer: which subagent to delegate to, which
command to suggest, and which checks a change implies — all derived from the prompt plus
the files in play. `scripts/agent/preflight.mjs` reads this file; `scripts/agent/doctor.mjs`
checks that it still matches the agent files on disk. Keep agent prose in the agent files,

direct: A single-file edit or a question with a known answer
One command to run, or one error to read
A docs-only change inside one file
delegate: The change spans layers (Rust core, Tauri shell, React UI, API)
The work sits in a specialist domain (Tauri/IPC, audio/DJ analysis)
Two or more independent work items that can proceed in parallel
delegation.handoff: RESULT — files changed | checks run | findings | remaining work | risks

postWhen: A finding changes another participant's plan
Work is blocked and a decision is needed (ASK)
Another agent's change touches a file you own (HOLD)
A scope change needs approval only the human can give (HOLD)

types.ASK: A question that blocks progress; name the decision needed
types.RESULT: Completed work worth integrating; name the files and checks
types.HOLD: Advisory pause on shared scope; say what would release it
types.VETO: Concrete objection to a proposed change; say what would work instead

agents.summary: Tauri v2 specialist: Rust commands, IPC, config, capabilities, plugins, builds.
agents.spawn: The task touches the Tauri shell: Rust commands, IPC contracts, capabilities, or a desktop build.

agents.summary: Audio and DJ library specialist: analysis, waveforms, beatgrid, tagging, local SQLite.
agents.spawn: The task touches audio analysis, waveforms, beatgrid/cues, or DJ library metadata.

agents.summary: Loads only the relevant slice of shared project memory for a task.
agents.spawn: The task needs prior decisions or conventions and the shared memory has not been searched yet.

agents.summary: Maps a task to the installed skill IDs worth loading, without doing the task.
agents.spawn: The skill match is ambiguous, or the task spans two domains and the right skills are unclear.

agents.summary: Regenerates the skill inventory and reports library drift, duplicates, and policy gaps.
agents.spawn: The installed skill library changed, or the priority policy needs curation.

agents.summary: Maintains the shared memory layers: de-duplicate, rotate state, promote corrections.
agents.spawn: A session produced something durable worth keeping, or the memory layers need pruning.

commands.summary: Run the automatic prompt brief: skills, memory, agents, and checks.
commands.use: The default entry point — run it on any non-trivial prompt before starting work.

commands.summary: Match the task to installed skills and load the winners.
commands.use: When only the skill routing is needed.

commands.summary: Run the skill-maintainer subagent and summarise the changes worth making.
commands.use: After installing, removing, or renaming skills.

commands.summary: Record something durable in the shared project memory.
commands.use: At the end of a session that produced something worth keeping.

commands.summary: Load the tauri-expert subagent with its skill set.
commands.use: Tauri shell, IPC, capability, or build work.

commands.summary: Load the audio-dj-expert subagent with its skill set.
commands.use: Audio analysis, waveform, beatgrid, rekordbox, beets, and library work.

commands.summary: Prune the machine-global skill library down to the skills this project uses.
commands.use: When the advertised skill cost is too high, or after installing a large batch of skills.
